headline: Will the use of the macuto make a comeback? Soon plastic bags will cost money
summary: Plastic bags will stop being free in the Dominican Republic from December 15, 2026, under Law 98-25 on integrated solid waste management. The measure aims to reduce plastic use.
why: Packaging and waste rules change costs for retailers and consumers and can shape demand for plastics and alternative packaging.
original_headline: ¿Regresará el uso del macuto? pronto las fundas plásticas costarán
